intro.title: Rush Resume
intro.subtitle: Rewrite your resume lines for one job, fast.
intro.whatThisIsBody: Rush works from the resume you already have and rewrites its lines. It does not build a new resume or learn your story. The full <link>Forge</link> takes longer and builds the real thing.

form.descriptionHint: (optional, but it makes it way better)
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Copy and paste the job posting here. The AI will tailor your resume to match what they're looking for.

errors.uploadFailed: File upload failed. Try pasting instead.

processing.workLabel: Working from the information you provided
processing.title: Rewriting your lines
processing.stillWorking: This is still working. We will show the text before you download it.

result.title: Your rewritten lines
result.notFinishedLead: This is not a finished resume.
result.notFinishedBody: It has no name, no employers and no dates. Paste each line into your own resume under the job it came from, and read every line before you send it.
result.previewNote: This shows the rewritten lines as a draft page. It is not a complete resume.
result.continueTailor: Continue editing in the Application Tailor
result.interviewLead: This gets you in the door, not through the interview.
result.interviewBody: Rush rewrites what you gave it and nothing more. It doesn't know your strengths, your story, or what makes you different. An interviewer will ask about all of that.
result.ctaBody: The Forge builds your real narrative: strengths, career paths, resources for your situation, and documents that hold up in an interview.

check.title: Check your resume. No sign-in.
check.intro: Paste it or upload the file. We check it against the basic rules and tell you what to fix. We don't save it.
check.tabsAria: How to give us your resume
check.fileHint: PDF, Word, text, or a photo. Up to 10 MB.

errors.rateLimited: You've used today's free checks from this connection. Try again tomorrow, or paste the text instead.
errors.couldNotCheck: We couldn't check that file. Try again, or paste the text instead.
errors.couldNotReach: We couldn't reach the checker. Try again, or paste the text instead.

check.markedNote: These are your words. We mark lines we can match to a specific finding. The full check is below. Nothing on the page has been rewritten yet.

summary.none: Nothing to fix in the checks we ran.
summary.mustFix: {count} to fix before you send it

check.ctaNote: These are the basic checks. The Forge goes line by line with you and builds the real thing.
